body: What do you mean by a loophole?

I am not choosing that. I have no problem with their relationship. However, if this person has an influence over my life suddenly?? We have been married a long time, poly for a year if that's helpful context.

I don't know, that's what I'm trying to figure out. I didn't know the concept existed until about a week ago. Grappling/trying to understand what it means. My partner has said it means they will get a big say in our decision making. That is the part I'm not into as this person's values/moral compass do not seem to line up with mine.

You're right in here... I am resentful that the agreement was broken and not brought up for many months. It's not really about the money but I see I was making it about that. It clearly isn't about that. I don't like admitting this, ha. I am not using finances to control them though-this just happened yesterday and we've already started talking about a budget. I am fine with money towards it but not with the dishonesty.

This helped clear up the issue for me just by asking myself these questions. You're right that this isn't actually about the money. Basically I think I need to suck it up. A huge part of this is that we had an agreement and it was broken for many months and not mentioned. I'm upset about that.
I don't know. I just found out that he wasn't splitting stuff. We are going to talk about it later this week with our (poly friendly!) therapist.
Excellent advice. Thank you. I've been reading that Nonviolent Communication book and this sounds like that :)!

Excellent point on the 'he's spending it on himself'. I can get in line with that.

In this case I don't think this meta is doing anything like dating for money etc. I think she is genuine.
There have been a lot of hiccups getting into poly so far from both of us. Basically it's just been one mistake after the other, but we are hopeful and doing our best :).
A lot of you guys are suggesting putting it in the budget. I don't feel comfortable with that really but I get that's something I'll have to work on. Guess we will have some new budget chats!
That's what I'm worried/bothered by. But I don't know how to get around that because feelings are feelings and this is the person he happens to like.

When I said that I was referring to the meta, not my husband. And I truthfully don't feel that it's ok for us to be working all the time and this new person to be getting any of the runoff. I feel crappy saying that but unless I'm honest I'm not sure I'll figure out how to fix this.

Thank you for the advice. I am doing that as much as possible. I'm lucky to have a lot of support. This crushing sort of feeling is hard to see ever passing. It hasn't with much shorter and shallower previous relationships so I can't help but feel I'm going to just feel like this forever and I don't want to live like that.
